title: dfu_job (Backend to agent)
description: Arms the agent for one bootloader-dfu update job on this socket, sent before the offer is relayed and only on a socket whose iface_relay declared serial_dfu. sha256 and size are those of the package the package route serves for the job (the DFU zip, byte for byte). Extra members are ignored.

job.description: The update job id; one URL path segment.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the package bytes, lower-case hex.
